coupons_value_range.name: coupons_value_range
coupons_value_range.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'free_shipping') or ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."value" >= 1)

orders_money_chk.name: orders_money_chk
orders_money_chk.value: "orders"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."delivery_fee_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."service_fee_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."total_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."commission_cents" >= 0 and "orders"."application_fee_cents" >= 0

orders_mode_chk.name: orders_mode_chk
orders_mode_chk.value: ("orders"."mode" = 'delivery' and "orders"."address" is not null) or ("orders"."mode" = 'pickup' and "orders"."pickup" is not null)
